title: 1815 Prairie's stone chimneys stay stone up to their heads
items: A strip of red brick showed under the head of each stone chimney on the Sears-Meeker house at 1815 Prairie Avenue. The chimney kit put that darker band on every stack, but it is meant for brick ones. Both old photographs show these stacks in pale stone right up to the head, so stone stacks now stay stone. No other house had a stone stack, so nothing else changed.
